name: aspen-cowork
description: Work an Aspen CRM from any host that loads the Aspen runtime MCP (.mcpb) — skills and a read-only explorer subagent for the Data + Describe tool surface: view, search, report on, create, and update records (up to 100 per confirmed call on Claude Code), attach files to them, and merge duplicate contacts. No CLI. Paired with the aspen-runtime-mcp server; on Claude Code the plugin starts the server itself, from a copy its bin/install-runtime-mcp.sh puts in place.
